page.layout: One page of text, no margins. Top: decorative ornament band, then a dedication title in capitals and small capitals, set in centred lines. Below: a verse dedication with a decorative initial N, set in lines of varying indent, with italic and roman type.

main_text.head: AD ILLUSTRISSIMUM ET POTENTISSIMUM PRINCIPEM ac Dominum D. Fridericum IIII. Comitem Palatinum ad Rhenum, ac Electoratus Heredem, Ducem Baua-riæ,&c. Dominum clementissimum.
main_text.p: NON usitato me rapit impetu PHOEBUS pauentem per liqui- dum æthera, Pennaque subnixum recenti TEUTONICÆ iubet arua tandem Lustrare Gentis: quâ vagus alueo Stagnante NICRUS mœnia subluit Urbis PALATINÆ, & propinquo Gestit aquas sociare RHENO. Quâ rupis altæ verticibus nitent Augusta MAGNI PRINCIPIS atria Quem PATRUUS reddit decore Perpetuo CASIMIRUS auctum: Dum curat illi ut cultibus indoles Firmata rectis, & penetralibus Nutrita sub faustis AVITAS

page.notes: The initial N is a decorative woodcut letter, joined to "ON" as NON. The dedication head is one unit: the hyphen in "Baua-riæ" is the printed line-end hyphen. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. Ornament band at top is not text. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible at the right and was left out.
